PJK1.name: A money decision needs an identity and a trail
PJK1.notes: OPEN on measured ground (2026-07-28). Six of seven project tables have NO auth_uid column at all - only `projects` has one - so raising or approving a CHANGE ORDER, which is a contract amendment, is attributable to nobody. And `projects` appears nowhere in hive_audit_log.target_type while assets, logbook, inventory_items, marketplace_listings, marketplace_sellers, worker_profiles and amc_briefings all do. AHK1 covered an approval DECISION on a forgeable name; here the identity column does not exist and the trail is absent entirely.

PJK2.name: A schedule/health number must be falsifiable
PJK2.notes: OPEN. renderCpm reads _progress.critical_path (item_ids, total_days, slack_per_item) and renderBudget reads _progress.earned_value (bac, pv, and a green/amber/red status), both computed in the project-progress edge fn with no in-repo oracle found at ground. AHK2 governed inspection TIMING; these decide which work may slip and what health a CLIENT is told. EVM has published formulas (CPI=EV/AC, SPI=EV/PV) so the thresholds are checkable against a standard, exactly as AH7's RPN was.

PJK3.name: Authority must be enforced where the data is
PJK3.notes: OPEN. Every project table carries ONE permissive FOR ALL policy whose WITH CHECK tests only hive_id IN user_hive_ids() - so any active member can approve, reject or cancel a change order. project_roles is the only table with a supervisor predicate. Separately, renderBudget refuses non-supervisors in the RENDERER ('Budget visibility is restricted to supervisors') while projects_hive_rw grants every member read - the number is one db.from('projects') away. Sharpens feedback_ui_only_approval_gate_is_bypassable from a button to a whole pane.

PJK4.name: A child row's parent must live in its own hive
PJK4.notes: CANDIDATE - to be EARNED by probing, not assumed from the analogy. No policy on project_items, project_change_orders, project_progress_logs, project_links or project_knowledge joins `projects`, so nothing checks that the parent project lives in the same hive. That is the PM13/AHK4 shape. Tracked in the denominator from day one BECAUSE the Asset Hub board read 100% with its fourth class untracked - a green headline over a missing axis produces no red.
